about_the_game:
Attack of Bunnies Demo – A Top-Down Shooter with Deep RPG Mechanics

Prepare for a wild ride in Attack of Bunnies Demo, a fast-paced top-down shooter fused with engaging RPG elements. This demo invites you to dive headfirst into a bunny-infested battlefield where quick reflexes, strategic upgrades, and relentless action are the keys to survival.

Key Features:

  • Five Playable Characters:
    Choose between two distinct heroes—each with unique abilities and playstyles—to find the one that best suits your approach. Whether you’re all about agile maneuvers or heavy-hitting firepower, your preferred character is ready to lead the charge against the bunny invasion.

  • One Immersive Level with 4 Difficulties:
    Explore a meticulously crafted level designed to challenge you in new ways. With four scalable difficulty settings, every run promises a fresh experience—perfect for both newcomers seeking a gentle introduction and veterans craving a tougher test of skill.

  • Robust Player Progression:
    Engage in fast-paced combat against waves of bunny grunt monsters to farm experience points. Level up your character, unlock new upgrades, and refine your abilities as you tailor your build to overcome escalating challenges.

  • Epic Boss Encounter:
    At the climax of your demo adventure, face off against a formidable boss monster. This high-stakes battle is the ultimate test of your tactical prowess and combat skills—do you have what it takes to vanquish this towering threat?

Gameplay Overview:

Step into a dynamic world where every encounter matters. The intuitive controls and responsive mechanics ensure that every dodge, shot, and strategic upgrade feels impactful. As you farm experience from hordes of relentless grunt monsters, you’ll unlock new skills that enhance your character’s combat effectiveness. The blend of shooter action and RPG progression keeps you engaged, challenging you to adapt and evolve with every playthrough.

Whether you’re a fan of precision shooting or deep customization, Attack of Bunnies Demo offers a satisfying glimpse into a larger universe of fast, furious, and fun gameplay. Download the demo on Steam today and join the battle—your adventure against the bunny hordes awaits!
